anomalies.description: A multi-vehicle collision occurs at the crosswalk: a red car and a black car collide head-on or at an angle in the intersection, causing the black car to spin and tilt dramatically; multiple motorcycles are involved or nearby, with riders reacting abruptly. Debris appears scattered, and vehicles show clear signs of impact and loss of control.

original_descriptions.description: A multi-vehicle collision occurs at the crosswalk: a red car and a black car collide head-on or at an angle in the intersection, causing the black car to spin and tilt dramatically; multiple motorcycles are involved or nearby, with riders reacting abruptly. A road accident occurs: a black car collides with a motorcycle at the intersection, causing the motorcycle to flip and rider(s) to be thrown onto the road. Multiple other motorcycles stop or gather around the crash site in subsequent frames, indicating an active collision event with visible debris and vehicle damage.

A road accident occurred: a motorcycle lies on its side on the road near a stopped black car at the intersection, with multiple people gathered around the scene, indicating a recent collision. The motorcycle appears to have been involved in a crash, and the situation persists across frames before clearing.

A road accident occurs: a red car and a black car collide at the intersection while multiple motorcycles are crossing the pedestrian crosswalk. The impact causes the black car to spin and one motorcycle to be struck and thrown to the ground, with riders falling. Debris is visible and vehicles are severely disrupted, consistent with a high-impact vehicle collision.

A road accident is occurring: a black car has collided with a motorcycle, which is lying on its side in the intersection. Multiple people are gathered around the crash site, including individuals attending to the fallen rider and others observing. The motorcycle appears to have been struck and thrown, consistent with a vehicle-motorcycle collision. Debris is visible near the vehicles, and traffic has halted around the incident.
